artifact_role: Late supplemental Semantic Scholar API reference-metadata pass; append-only audit evidence, not an official validator or scientific result

actual_execution_order.protocol_prescribed_order: Tier 0 API before Tier 1/2 source work
actual_execution_order.actual_order: Current-round primary-source A1/WebSearch work was already completed before this supplemental API run. No earlier Tier-0 execution is asserted, no prior searches are relabelled, and no prior A1 work is skipped or replaced retroactively.

api_run.raw_response_retention: Every actual HTTP response body, request URL, status, timestamp, byte count and raw-body SHA-256 is retained in reference_results[].attempts[]. Unattempted references have attempts=[] and attempted=false.

helper.operation: Read exact locked bibliography files; GET explicit S2 endpoints; emit NDJSON stdout only. No cache, evidence, manuscript or source-file writes. Redirect following is disabled.

reference_population.inventory_time_boundary: This is the later local inventory serialization time, not a source-retrieval timestamp. The same exact bibliography bindings matched at API-run intake and at this serialization.

transport_policy.network_error_action: Stop remaining S2 batch and explicitly record API_UNAVAILABLE.
transport_policy.http_5xx_action: Skip the affected reference to existing A1.
transport_policy.exhausted_429_action: Stop remaining S2 batch and explicitly record API_UNAVAILABLE.
transport_policy.permission_action: Stop S2 without bypass or credential extraction.

matching_method.algorithm: Levenshtein similarity = 1 - edit_distance/max(normalized lengths); threshold 0.70; matching year preferred among qualifying title-search results.
matching_method.title_projection: Remove BibTeX grouping/backslash/dollar delimiters and formatting-command names; collapse whitespace for API query. Preserve every raw BibTeX field separately. Similarity normalization is case-insensitive and removes Unicode punctuation.
matching_method.limits: The threshold is a candidate metadata check, not semantic wrong-work adjudication, complete bibliographic validation, source-passage support or scientific proof. S2 metadata may combine preprint, accepted-manuscript and published versions.
